claims.claim: UCX_IB_ROCE_REACHABILITY_MODE is an enum with route as the default and route, local_subnet, and all values; all is documented as assuming every address reachable without a check.

During RoCE interface initialization, legacy ROCE_LOCAL_SUBNET=y overrides the selected mode to local_subnet; prefix bits are otherwise reset to zero unless the GID is RoCEv2 and local_subnet mode is active.

For a RoCE-to-RoCE address that has passed the outer link-layer and PKEY checks, all mode returns reachable before RoCE version, address-family, GID conversion, subnet, or route checks; this classification does not prove transport connectivity.
Route mode requires a RoCE netdev and accepts the best netdev route, a qualifying loopback route, or a kernel local route; otherwise it fills a no-route information string and returns unreachable.

Local-subnet mode treats a zero-bit prefix as universally reachable and otherwise returns the same-subnet comparison; the existing RoCE gtest only demonstrates successful traffic under local_subnet mode.
